Group achievements

Recognitions

  • 7 July 2025: Aseem Baranwal has won the SCS PhD Dissertation Award!

  • 29 November 2024: Aseem Baranwal is one of the top 20 reviewers at the Learning on Graphs Conference. See the annoucement here.

  • 24 April 2023: Shenghao’s paper Weighted flow diffusion for local graph clustering with node attributes: an algorithm and statistical guarantees was accepted at ICML 2023 as Oral & Poster, top 3%.

  • 21 January 2023: Aseem’s paper Effects of Graph Convolutions in Multi-layer Networks was accepted at at ICLR 2023 as Spotlight, top 6%.

  • 10 December 2022: Aseem Baranwal is one of the top 20 reviewers at the Learning on Graphs Conference. See the annoucement here.

  • 30 April 2022: Our paper Graph Attention Retrospective won the best paper award at the GroundedML workshop.

  • 20 December 2021: Shenghao Yang was featured at Mathematics News.

  • 22 July 2021: Shenghao Yang was a finalist for the best student presentation prize at SIAM ACDA. His talk was on Local Hyper-flow Diffusion. You can find the video here.

  • 16 May 2021: Aseem’s paper Graph Convolution for Semi-Supervised Classification: Improved Linear Separability and Out-of-Distribution Generalization was accepted at ICML 2021 as Spotlight, top 6%.
